children: Canada cannabis retailer's fiscal Q3 revenue rose 33% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q3 set a record and beat analyst expectations
Company attributes results to operating leverage and growth in Canada and Germany
High Tide reiterates long-term goal of surpassing 350 Canadian locations and opening 20+ in 2026
Company anticipates significant long-term growth in white label cannabis portfolio and loyalty programs
High Tide expects to sustain or grow share of German medical cannabis market, monitoring U.S. regulatory changes
CANADA RETAIL EXPANSION - Co said growth in Canna Cabana store count and increased market share contributed to record revenue
GERMAN MEDICAL CANNABIS - Record distribution volumes and revenue at Remexian subsidiary in Germany drove results
OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY - Lower operating expenses as a percentage of revenue supported margin improvement
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 6 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the drug retailers peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for High Tide Inc is C$7.00, about 100.6% above its September 11 closing price of C$3.49
The stock recently traded at 17 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 25 three months ago
